metaTitle: API Documentation — Translate PDFs Programmatically | TranslatePDFOnline
metaDescription: Integrate PDF translation into your workflow with our REST API. Use API keys to translate PDFs programmatically. Code examples in cURL, Python, and Node.js.
keywords: pdf translation api, rest api, translate pdf programmatically, ocr api, document translation api
heroText: Translate PDFs programmatically with our simple REST API. Get an API key from your settings and start translating PDFs in minutes.
authenticationDesc: Include your API key in requests using either an Authorization header (Bearer token) or an X-API-Key header. Create and manage your keys in Settings → API Keys.
rateLimitingDesc: Each API key is limited to 60 requests per minute. Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining) are included in every response.
pricingDesc: Translation uses the current per-page credit rate shown in the product. Check the live rate and your balance in Settings → Credits before submitting a task.

seoFaq.q1: How do I get an API key for PDF translation?
seoFaq.a1: Sign up at translatepdfonline.com, go to Settings → API Keys, and click "Create API Key". Copy your key immediately — it will not be shown again.
seoFaq.q2: What languages does the translation API support?
seoFaq.a2: The API supports 10 languages: English (en), Chinese (zh), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it), Greek (el), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), German (de), and Russian (ru).
seoFaq.q3: How much does it cost to use the API?
seoFaq.a3: The per-page rate comes from the current runtime configuration and is shown in the product. Starter credits may be available when enabled; check Settings → Credits for the live balance and offer.
seoFaq.q4: How do I check the status of my translation?
seoFaq.a4: After submitting a translation, you receive a task_id. Poll GET /api/tasks/{task_id} to check the status (queued → processing → completed/failed).
seoFaq.q5: Is there a rate limit on the API?
seoFaq.a5: Yes, each API key is limited to 60 requests per minute. If you exceed this limit, you will receive a 429 response. Contact us if you need a higher limit.
